reviews.x: I'll have to admit, I was very skeptical about whether or not tgis product would work. The commercial showed a bunch of little Caucasian girls and claimed to work on all hair types. My daughter is Dominican and Puerto Rican with super, duper fine, tight curly hair. Brushing her hair is a nightmare. So I tried brushing her hair while dry and knotted. She didn't even complain and she's 2. She always cries when I brush her hair. Might be a fluke but I like it so far.

Cannot believe this actually works but it does! My daughter has shoulder length and fine hair that knots into a nest when she sleeps. Or walks. Or watches tv. She screams when I brush it, and I’ve bought numerous different brushes and detanglers. It’s probably just bc it’s so cute that makes her WANT to brush her hair. I don’t even care the reason, she’s actually brushing her hair and I no longer have to threaten to shave it all off. Yay!!!

reviews.t: White tips on the brush bristles fall off
reviews.x: I bought this for my daughter (4) for Xmas. At first it worked great. My daughter has curly hair and knots up easy. Over the past couple weeks the white tips on the bristles have consistently fallen off. Now the brush can’t be used cause it scratches my daughters scalp when we try. If I knew the brush only worked for a few months I’d have bought something else.

reviews.t: Adorable, Easy to Use Detangling Brush
reviews.x: My girls (ages 4 and 6) are absolutely in love with this brush!  They think of it as more of a toy than a brush and they were tickled to find it has its own name--"Cupcake the Cat."  It's easy to use and hard to lose (because of the color and toy-like design).  It works perfectly for detangling wet hair after bath or showers.  (However, it is not ideal for making every day hairstyles, such as ponytails and braids, just because the brush it a bit wide and harder to hold for doing more than coming

I purchased this for my 3 year old thinking it would be more of a toy (I have to admit skepticism of Shark Tank or other heavily advertised items); however, it actually does a surprisingly good job with tangles in my daughter's fine hair while pulling substantially less than most brushes. It fits perfectly in her hand, and comes apart for cleaning without popping apart during regular use

My daughter does wonderful in the morning except for hair brushing time....!!ah!  I try to be gentle she cries and would much rather go to school with "bed-head" than work through the torturous hair brushing routine.  This tangle-pet was her idea and of course in my desperation I ordered it! I can honestly share that it has been my Mommy-saver!!  We don't leave the house now without her asking me (wow!) to use Cupcake the Kitty to brush through her long hair.  She's happy and Mommy is definitely

reviews.t: Super cute yet practical as it works great as a brush!
reviews.x: This kitty brush is so adorable and our little girls really like it! Bought as a Valentine’s gift for our girls with some other pampering goodies. It does seem to work through the tangles fairly well, whether wet or dry, but does still require some tugging still as 2 year old fusses still, but definitely not as much as she was with a regular comb or brush!  Would buy another one in the future!  It comes out too, so the cat can be a little friend or washed and brushed cleaned easier.

This is the absolutely best hair brush for a little 4 year old with thick hair that I've ever seen in my life.  It is a life saver.  With this brush and some leave in hair conditioner, my granddaughter does not complain about having her hair done.  She even brushes her own hair sometimes.  Seriously if your child squirms and complains "you're hurting my head" this is the brush for you!

My little one hates having her long hair brushed, unless we use this. For some reason, she claims this brush doesn’t hurt. She adores it! Gets out the tangles and is easier to hold than it looks. We left the first one in a hotel by mistake, and immediately overnighted a second one before she noticed it was gone. That’s how much it’s loved.

Got this for a friends little girl as someone gifted us the unicorn one for our daughter for christmas and we LOVE them. My 5 yr old lives brushing her hair! No more fighting and makes my morning so much nicer!
I bought this as a little gift for my 7 yr old granddaughter.  When it arrived, I thought it was a bit too 'young' for her but she loves it!  She has very long hair and it removes tangles easily.
Wow! So glad ! Girl wants to brush her hair now! And it does exactly what it says! Helps detangle without all the drama! What a blessing!

reviews.t: so easy to get her to brush her hair
reviews.x: Purchased for my 5 year old niece she loves it and so easy to get her to brush her hair
My 2 long haired kids love it. Makes hairbrushing less of a nightmare.
My daughter loves this. We bought the kitty.

I thought that the brush was a cute idea when I saw it on Shark Tank and didn't really expect much more than "cuteness".  My grand daughter is 3 years old and her hair is pretty long.  It tangles badly no matter how many times you brush it and it takes at least 30 minutes to get through the massive tangles.  My first time using it on her I didn't really have high expectations.  I am shocked that I was able to brush her whole head in around 5 minutes.  I still heard the owe, owe, owe, even when I

reviews.t: In love with this Tangled Pet Brush!
reviews.x: We LOVE our Tangle Pet brush!!! My Granddaughter got one for Christmas from her Aunt and now we’ve bought another one, so I can have one at my house. It’s well worth the money, if you have tangled hair, or know someone who does. Can’t say enough! Oh my goodness...we have a little girl that wakes up every morning with a frizzy, tangled mess. We call it a rats nest, or rooster.😉 She loves her hair long and it was always a struggle, bc she hated her hair brushed. Now she can even brush her hair by

My girls (2 and 7) and I absolutely LOVE this brush! My girls love the cute purple kitty and don't complain about brushing their hair. Its a great size for their small hands. I love that it is super gentle on their long, thick hair and easily smooths their tangles. I also think it is brilliant that you can take it apart and wash the plush cat when necessary. This is such a clever brush. We will definitely be ordering another!

reviews.t: my daughter likes that its a cat, and that is it
reviews.x: i am lucky that for the most part, my daughter lets me brush her hair, I know other kids have a tough time with this, I ordered this for her stocking because I thought she would like the kitty and having her own hairbrush. Well, it's not easier on tangles, it's not easy to hold and the bristles are very pokey. she still prefers to use my hairbrush. but she loves to play with the cat in her dollhouse so there is that I guess.

reviews.t: Got this for my 4 year old
reviews.x: Super cute brush. It actually brushes very well. I have a 4 year old who absolutely refuses to let me brush her hair. I even purchased those “wet” brushes. It helped a little but once my kid saw this she freaked. She “had” to have it. It is pricy for a small brush with an animal on it but it was worth the money. She lets me brush her hair with no fuss. Very happy with the product. It isn’t cheap made either.

My 7 year old has thin (But a lot) hair. She gets these tiny knots that if I use a normal brush she screams bloody murder. With the Tangle pets, she has never screamed, not even once. I even have started using it on my hair. I have very very very fine hair (and NOT a lot lol). Every other brush hurts, But this one I have had not one issue with. Highly recommend it!!!

At first I thought this was a little expensive. And then I thought of my grand-daughter and how much it hurts to brush her hair. I then, immediately ordered it for her. My daughter said that it works REALLY good and that she will be buying one for her son, also. They really do get the tangles out. Worth every penny!!! Soooo cute!! Can a grandma get one too?

reviews.t: Super cute, but glides over tangles
reviews.x: My daughter loves it, and so did our dog (this is our second one because he ate the first) but I have found that more often than not—it glides over the tangles, and I have to use another brush to get those out. If your child has short hair that doesn’t tangle, this would be a good option, but for those with long hair that’s prone to tangle, just be aware.

reviews.t: Works well when bristles don’t fall out
reviews.x: Brush works great when the bristles are in the brush, but the bristles come out of the brush really easily which sucks when you’re trying to brush out a toddlers hair. It doesn’t seem like the bristles are attached to the brush itself, they’re attached to the plastic backing for the bristles but that whole thing pops out. It’s great when it’s whole

I have bought my daughter this brush as a stocking stuffer for Christmas. We have had it over 3 months and we still use it every day. Her hair looks like a bees nest when she gets up, it gets the tangled out without pulling out her hair or hurting her. I will buy another when the time comes to replace it.

claims.text: Reviewers widely report the brush effectively detangles hair and reduces brushing struggles, especially for children with fine or curly hair.
Many customers say their children love the brush and are now willing or eager to brush their own hair, turning it into less of a battle.
The cute, toy-like cat design is frequently praised as adorable and appealing to kids.
Some reviewers were initially skeptical of the heavily advertised product but were surprised that it actually works.
One reviewer reports the white tips on the bristles fall off over time, making the brush scratchy and unusable.
